question: How many of the single bond type molecules are non-carcinogenic?

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "molecule_bondtypes_labels" AS CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE molecule_bondtypes_labels AS
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN instr(part1, '_') > 0 THEN left(part1, instr(part1, '_') - 1) ELSE part1 END AS molecule_id,
    attribute_value AS bond_type
  FROM table_1
  WHERE bond_id = 'lx' AND attribute_value IS NOT NULL AND part1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT f.molecule_id, f.bond_type, t2.sign
FROM filtered f
JOIN table_2 t2 ON t2.code = f.molecule_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "molecule_bondtypes_labels" AS WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN instr(part1, '_') > 0 THEN left(part1, instr(part1, '_') - 1) ELSE part1 END AS molecule_id,
    trim(attribute_value) AS bond_type
  FROM table_1
  WHERE bond_id = 'lx' AND attribute_value IS NOT NULL AND part1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT f.molecule_id, f.bond_type, t2.sign
FROM filtered f
JOIN table_2 t2 ON t2.code = f.molecule_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH per_mol AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS non_single_bond_count,
         COUNT(*) AS total_bonds
  FROM molecule_bondtypes_labels
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
single_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM per_mol
  WHERE non_single_bond_count = 0 AND total_bonds > 0
),
non_carcinogenic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM molecule_bondtypes_labels
  WHERE sign = '-'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM single_molecules sm
JOIN non_carcinogenic nc ON nc.molecule_id = sm.molecule_id
